src.description: DID of the moderation service returning this status.

expiresAt.description: Time at which the current suspension expires. Present only for a temporary suspension.

updatedAt.description: Newest account-status update or strike timestamp used to derive this standing, or the Unix epoch when neither exists. This is not a standing-transition timestamp; expiry can change standing without changing this value.

did.description: Account to preview. Only Ozone staff can read another account; this does not change its read state.

main.description: Get the authenticated account's current standing with this moderation service.
